title: FinCrime Knowledge Pack Manifest
description: The manifest of an immutable, dated knowledge pack. The manifest is the pack's index and its integrity record: every record is listed with the hash of its file, and the pack checksum is derived from those hashes. A pack whose contents no longer match its manifest is not the pack anybody reviewed, so it is rejected. See ADR-0006.

id.description: The pack id, for example core-2026-10.

jurisdictions.description: A 'global' or empty jurisdiction list is invalid. Regulatory content is never jurisdiction-agnostic.

path.description: A pack-relative path to the record file.

checksum.description: The pack checksum: the sha256 of the canonical JSON of the record index, sorted by record id.
